generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-2 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on
All necessary drawings, paper works, etc. and any other formalities required to be observed shall be the responsibility of contractor
Whenever executing authority insist proof of having purchased the materials (used during executing the work) for verification. The contractor has to produce the purchase bills.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
Conditional tenders are not accepted.

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates, which shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and thirty first day of March inclusive
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tender without assigning any reason.
Tenderer shall note, that the tenderers those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal

All the items includes all Leads and Lifts, Loading and Unloading, transportation charges, Cost of all materials, Labour, HOM of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and all other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work
The bidder should be a reputed company registered as a Class III and above Civil Contractor with PWD, Govt. of Karnataka and should have suitable technical, financial & managerial capabilities
The contractor shall not deviate/alter/execute excess quantities or additional items without the prior approval
The Cost of the tender form shall not be refundable.
Further particulars, if any, required by the contractor can be had from the O/o the Executive Engineer, No.1 buildings Division during office hours.
Agency Should upload Employees provident fund (EPF) & ESI registration certificate, and also should upload copy of receipt of the last six months for the payment made for the same
The Tenderer should submit Latest GST clearance certificate
The quantities shown in the schedule are approximate. The actual quantities will be executed as per site condition only. Any balance materials shall be taken back by the contractor.
Tenderer should be registered in labour department & submit labour registration certificate
Tenderers must provide the address with valid proof of address along with latest photographs of all the employees who are employed in this work to the concerned authority
Tenderers must provide insurance to all the employees executing this work.
The Labours deployed shall mandatorily wear the face mask, hand gloves and take all safety measures to protect labours and staff

Bidder should upload the bid capacity calculated as per KW-2 tender condition, The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per clause 3.1
The Quoted Rates Shall be Excluding GST
The tenderers / firms must submit GST certificate.
The tenderer must submit a certificate of registration from the Department of Labour
The tenderer must submit a certificate of registration of service tax
To follow and abide by the guidelines along with terms and conditions given by this office in this copy
The minimum rate for the development of the concerned park should be mentioned unit-wise in the tender schedule received from this office.
The tender shall be rejected or considered by Executive Engineer without assigning any reason

The final decision will be taken by the competent authority. The bidders should abide by this. The complete Authority reserves the right to accept or reject the tender without assigning any reason thereof

FIVE PERCENT of approved tender amount to be submitted as security deposit in their name or in the form of a bank guarantee and sign an agreement with the department on a printed paper of appropriate value. No interest will be paid on this amount. It will be returned when the work is completed. The tenderer reserves the right to forfeit this amount partially or fully in case of violation of any condition / rule

Provision of water facility (borewell etc.) by the concerned authority, if there is a problem of irrigation, the tenderer in consultation with the concerned authorities should make the irrigation system required for the development of the park as per the prescribed blue map in the form of a loan, then the bill will be paid according to the availability of the grant.
The tenderer must be committed to minor and appropriate changes in the blue map.

The tenderers should work under the guidance of the Deputy Director of Horticulture / concerned in-charge engineer of the department and should be ready to cultivate the trees mentioned by them. All the tools and grass should be of good quality during the development of the park and all the tools and grass should be used without any deficiency in the fixed volume and all the tools should be collected separately before use, the description of the volume should be given and then used

In the area where the development of the park is to be carried out without affecting the park and amenities existing, if any losses in this regard are caused, the tenderer concerned will be held directly responsible and appropriate penalties will be imposed.

The tenderer shall complete the development work of the park area technically and adequately within a maximum period of 30 days from the date of award of the work order. And after the completion of the work, the maintenance should be responsible for the maintenance of the said park for 2 months.
The tenant will be paid the bill as per the availability of the grant as soon as the work is completed.
According to the government circular related to the said work, all taxes will be deducted from the original bill and deposited to the government, the tenderers must abide by this.
The tender has been invited as per the Karnataka Transparency Rules and is subject to all the provisions of this Act
The tenderers shall abide by the Government orders and circulars issued from time to time
If the dates fixed in the tender notice are accidentally declared as a government holiday, it will be considered as the date on which the next government office will work
More information and complete details can be obtained by visiting this office during office hours

Since horticulture technology is the mainstay of the development of parks and is beautifully attractive with ornamental plants, only contractors who are skilled in horticulture works are eligible to tender

Bidder Must have at least 3 years of experience in the field of landscape design with Govt/aided instructions & provide Experience Certificate with certificate of Degree in Agriculture / Horticulture detailed report of the company (If the owner of the institution is not a graduate in Agriculture / Horticulture, the certificate of graduation / diploma in Horticulture in his institution, if he is a partner or employee. In addition, the institution should have separate technical staff having expertise in landscaping, attesting to their involvement / working in the institution and attesting to the satisfactory performance of such works in the past by the Government Institution / Government Subsidiary.

The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx5-B) Where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited 3 months.
